comment: Words the dialogue uses that are not in the catalog. 'forms' are the stems an eojeol may start with; the rest must be a particle or an ending (DialogueCoverage.TAILS). 'known' marks everyday words a beginner is expected to have met; every other word counts as new and is glossed on hover. A line may have at most one new word.
